켤레.forms: native number + 켤레: 신발 한 켤레 · 양말 두 켤레
켤레.x: Three pairs of socks are 5,000 won.
켤레.e: For things that come in pairs: 양말 한 켤레 = one pair of socks.

카페.x: I drank coffee with a friend at a café.
카페.e: From French/English 'café'. Online, 카페 also means a community forum (like Naver Café).

마음.x: That person has a warm heart.
마음.e: The emotional heart (the organ is 심장). 마음에 들다 is lit. 'enter the heart'.
마음.t: 마음에 들다 = 'to like, to be to one's liking': 이 가방이 마음에 들어요.

타다.m: to ride, to take (a vehicle), to get on
타다.x: I take the subway to work.
타다.t: The vehicle takes 을/를: 버스를 타요. Also 자전거를 타다 'ride a bike'.

타다.m: to burn, to be burned; to get tanned
타다.ex: 고기를 너무 오래 구워서 다 탔어요.
타다.x: I grilled the meat too long, so it all burned.
타다.e: Homonym warning: 타다 also means 'ride', 'mix in' and 'receive (a prize)'.
타다.t: Sun can 'burn' you too: 얼굴이 탔어요 = my face got tanned.

지다.ex: 어제 축구 경기에서 우리 팀이 졌어요.
지다.x: Our team lost the soccer match yesterday.
지다.e: Opposite of 이기다. A different 지다 means 'set': 해가 지다 = the sun sets.

지다.m: to set (sun, moon); to wither, to fall (flowers, leaves)
지다.ex: 여름에는 저녁 여덟 시쯤 해가 져요.
지다.x: In summer, the sun sets around eight in the evening.
지다.e: Homonym warning: 지다 also means 'to lose' (a game) and 'to carry on your back'.
지다.t: Opposite pairs: 해가 뜨다 (sun rises) vs. 해가 지다 (sun sets); 꽃이 피다 vs. 꽃이 지다.

미안하다.t: To elders or strangers, 죄송합니다 is more polite than 미안해요.

세일.x: The department store is having a sale this weekend.
세일.t: 세일 is a store-wide sale event; 할인 is any discount, like a student discount.

크기.x: These two bags are about the same size.
크기.e: 크다 'big' plus the noun suffix -기: literally 'bigness'.
크기.t: 크기 is general size of any object; for clothing sizes, Koreans usually say 사이즈.

질문하다.x: If there's anything you don't know, ask anytime.
질문하다.t: With superiors, use 질문을 드리다 instead of 질문하다.

졸업식.ex: 부모님이 제 졸업식에 꽃을 들고 오셨어요.
졸업식.x: My parents came to my graduation with flowers.

회원.ex: 회원이 되면 책을 무료로 빌릴 수 있어요.
회원.x: If you become a member, you can borrow books for free.

배추.x: My mom makes kimchi with napa cabbage.
배추.e: Probably from an old borrowed reading of Chinese 'white vegetable'; now felt as native.
배추.t: A whole head of cabbage is counted with 포기: 배추 한 포기.

헤어지다.m: to break up; to part, to say goodbye
헤어지다.ex: 어제 남자 친구와 헤어져서 너무 슬퍼요.
헤어지다.x: I broke up with my boyfriend yesterday, so I'm very sad.
헤어지다.e: One verb for both everyday 'part ways' after meeting and romantic 'break up'.

최고.x: The kimchi my mom makes is the best.
최고.t: 최고! on its own is a common compliment meaning 'the best!' or 'awesome!'.

센티미터.forms: Sino numbers + 센티미터: 오십 센티미터, 백 센티미터; written cm
센티미터.ex: 제 동생은 작년보다 키가 오 센티미터 컸어요.
센티미터.x: My younger sibling grew five centimeters taller than last year.
센티미터.e: From English 'centimeter'; often shortened to 센티 in speech.

틀다.forms: 틀어요 · 틀었어요 · 틀 거예요 · 트세요 (ㄹ drops)
틀다.m: to turn on (TV, radio, AC, music); to twist, to turn
틀다.x: It was so hot that I turned on the air conditioner.
틀다.e: Core idea 'twist': old dials and faucets were twisted on.
틀다.t: 틀다 is common for media and AC; for lights use 켜다.

소원.ex: 제 소원은 세계 여행을 하는 거예요.
소원.x: My wish is to travel around the world.
소원.t: Make a wish with 빌다: 생일 케이크 앞에서 소원을 빌어요.

여우.ex: 옛날이야기에는 꾀 많은 여우가 자주 나와요.
여우.x: Clever foxes often appear in old folktales.
여우.e: Native word. Korean folklore has the 구미호, a nine-tailed fox spirit that turns into a beautiful woman.
여우.t: Calling someone 여우 or saying 여우 같다 means they are sly, or cleverly charming; it can be teasing or a real criticism depending on tone.

주부.x: My mother is a homemaker who runs the household.

체험.ex: 한옥 마을에서 전통 문화 체험을 했어요.
체험.x: I tried some hands-on traditional culture activities at a hanok village.
체험.e: Literally 'test with the body': learning by doing it yourself.
체험.t: 체험 is a specific firsthand try-out, like 김치 만들기 체험; 경험 is experience in general.

먼지.ex: 오랫동안 청소를 안 해서 책상에 먼지가 쌓였어요.
먼지.x: I haven't cleaned in a long time, so dust has piled up on my desk.

배신하다.x: He never betrayed his friend, right to the end.
배신하다.t: Takes a direct object: 친구를 배신하다 = to betray a friend.

비율.ex: 우리 학교는 여학생의 비율이 더 높아요.
비율.x: Our school has a higher proportion of female students.
비율.t: The 'rate' syllable is 율 after a vowel or ㄴ (비율, 할인율) and 률 elsewhere (확률).

교체.x: The broken part needs to be replaced.

폐렴.x: My grandmother's cold got worse, and she was hospitalized with pneumonia.
폐렴.t: Spelled 폐렴 with ㄹ, unlike 위염 or 장염 — just memorize it; pronounced [페렴].

수시.m: early admission (non-CSAT college admission); any time, frequently
수시.ex: 저는 이번 수시에서 원하는 대학에 합격했어요.
수시.x: I got into the college I wanted through early admission this time.
수시.e: Literally 'following the time'; short for 수시 모집, admissions held through the fall.
수시.t: As an adverb, 수시로 means 'frequently, at any time': 수시로 확인하세요.

졸업생.ex: 졸업생들이 학교에 와서 후배들에게 조언을 해 줬어요.
졸업생.x: Graduates came to the school and gave advice to younger students.

자퇴.x: He dropped out of school because of health problems.
자퇴.t: 자퇴 is your own choice; 퇴학 means being expelled.

교내.x: You can't smoke on school grounds.
교내.t: Mostly used with 에서 or before nouns: 교내 식당, 교내 대회.

사물놀이.ex: 축제에서 사물놀이 공연을 보고 신이 났어요.
사물놀이.x: I got excited watching the samulnori performance at the festival.
사물놀이.e: Literally 'playing four things': 꽹과리, 징, 장구, 북.

대중성.ex: 이 영화는 작품성과 대중성을 모두 갖췄어요.
대중성.x: This movie has both artistic quality and mass appeal.

고전.ex: 방학 동안 고전 소설을 몇 권 읽었어요.
고전.x: I read a few classic novels over vacation.
고전.t: Classical music is technically 고전 음악, but people almost always say 클래식.

가설.x: The scientists confirmed the hypothesis through experiments.
가설.e: Literally 'temporary theory' — one not yet proven.
가설.t: Common pattern: 가설을 세우다 'to form a hypothesis'.

드론.x: I took photos of the sea from the sky with a drone.
드론.t: To fly a drone is 드론을 날리다, not 드론을 타다.

계획적.ex: 그는 계획적인 사람이라서 매일 일정을 정리해요.
계획적.x: He's a methodical person, so he organizes his schedule every day.
계획적.t: Can also mean 'premeditated' in a bad sense: 계획적인 범죄 'a premeditated crime'.

욕심쟁이.ex: 제 동생은 과자를 혼자 다 먹는 욕심쟁이예요.
욕심쟁이.x: My little brother is a greedy guy who eats all the snacks by himself.
욕심쟁이.e: 'Desire-heart' plus -쟁이, 'person who habitually is so': 겁쟁이, 거짓말쟁이.

우유부단하다.ex: 그는 우유부단해서 메뉴 하나도 잘 못 골라요.
우유부단하다.x: He's so indecisive he can't even pick one item off a menu.
우유부단하다.e: Literally 'soft and gentle, unable to cut' — too soft to make a decision.
우유부단하다.t: Nothing to do with 우유 'milk' — it's a four-character idiom.

되살리다.m: to revive, to bring back to life; to restore
되살리다.ex: 이 노래는 어린 시절의 추억을 되살려 줘요.
되살리다.x: This song brings back childhood memories.
되살리다.e: 되- 'again' + 살리다 'to keep alive', the causative of 살다.

두드리다.m: to knock, to tap, to beat
두드리다.x: Someone knocked on the door, so I went to check.

쳐다보다.m: to look at, stare at; to look up at
쳐다보다.x: People stared at me as if I were strange.
쳐다보다.t: Pronounced [처다보다]; it often suggests staring, which can feel rude.

여행객.x: Myeongdong is always crowded with foreign tourists.

의제.m: agenda, agenda item, topic for discussion
의제.ex: 오늘 회의의 첫 번째 의제는 예산 문제입니다.
의제.x: The first item on today's meeting agenda is the budget issue.

선비.m: (Joseon) classical scholar; a learned man of integrity
선비.ex: 선비는 돈보다 학문과 예의를 중요하게 생각했어요.
선비.x: A seonbi valued learning and courtesy more than money.
선비.e: Not Sino-Korean; names the Joseon ideal of a poor but upright, learned man.

사조.m: trend of thought, (intellectual or artistic) movement
사조.x: Impressionism is an art movement that began in 19th-century France.

연유하다.m: to originate from, to be due to
연유하다.ex: 그의 성격은 어린 시절의 경험에서 연유한 것입니다.
연유하다.x: His personality stems from his childhood experiences.
연유하다.t: The noun sounds literary: 무슨 연유로 오셨어요? 'For what reason have you come?'

불거지다.m: to come to the surface, to emerge (of problems or suspicions); to bulge out
불거지다.ex: 회사 내부의 문제가 언론을 통해 불거졌습니다.
불거지다.x: Problems inside the company came to light through the media.
불거지다.e: Literally 'to bulge out' — a hidden issue swells until everyone sees it.
불거지다.t: News collocations: 의혹이 불거지다 'suspicions surface', 논란이 불거지다 'controversy erupts'.

구비하다.m: to have (all that is needed), to be equipped with, to provide
구비하다.ex: 지원자는 필요한 서류를 모두 구비해야 합니다.
구비하다.x: Applicants must have all the required documents ready.
구비하다.e: Literally 'equip and prepare' — having everything needed on hand.

내몰리다.m: to be driven out, to be forced (into a situation)
내몰리다.ex: 많은 상인들이 높은 임대료 때문에 거리로 내몰렸습니다.
내몰리다.x: Many shopkeepers were driven out onto the streets by high rents.
내몰리다.e: 내- 'out' + 몰리다 'to be driven': herded out.

순종적.ex: 그 강아지는 아주 순종적이라서 훈련하기 쉬워요.
순종적.x: That puppy is very obedient, so it's easy to train.

전대미문.x: This was an unheard-of case of fraud.
전대미문.e: Literally 'never heard of in previous generations.'

보수.ex: 이 지역은 전통적으로 보수 성향이 강해요.
보수.x: This region has traditionally leaned strongly conservative.
보수.e: Literally 'protect and keep' what already exists.
보수.t: Homonyms: 보수 can also mean pay or wages, or repair, with different hanja.

유통업.ex: 온라인 쇼핑이 늘면서 유통업이 빠르게 변하고 있어요.
유통업.x: The retail industry is changing quickly as online shopping grows.
유통업.e: Literally 'flow-through industry' — moving goods to buyers.

편입생.ex: 올해 우리 학과에 편입생이 다섯 명 들어왔어요.
편입생.x: Five transfer students joined our department this year.
편입생.t: 편입생 is used for college transfers; for elementary through high school, say 전학생.

자부하다.m: to pride oneself on, to be proud of
자부하다.x: Our company prides itself on having the best technology.
자부하다.e: Literally 'carry it on yourself' — confidently backing your own ability.
자부하다.t: The noun 자부심 'pride' is more common in speech: 자부심을 느끼다.

열반.m: nirvana; death of the Buddha or a great monk
열반.ex: 부처는 여든 살에 열반에 들었다고 전해집니다.
열반.x: The Buddha is said to have entered nirvana at the age of eighty.
열반.e: A sound transliteration of Sanskrit 'nirvana', so the syllables themselves carry no meaning.
열반.t: 열반에 들다 is also a respectful way to say a revered monk has passed away.

서글프다.ex: 나이가 들수록 혼자인 게 서글플 때가 있어요.
서글프다.x: The older I get, sometimes being alone feels sad.
서글프다.e: Related to 슬프다 'sad': a quieter, lonelier kind of sadness.

원천기술.ex: 이 회사는 배터리 원천기술을 많이 가지고 있습니다.
원천기술.x: This company holds a lot of core original battery technology.
원천기술.e: Literally 'wellspring technology' — the technology everything else flows from.

품질관리.x: This factory is known for its strict quality control.
품질관리.t: Pronounced [품질괄리] — ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ.

표현주의.ex: 표현주의 화가들은 강한 색으로 내면의 감정을 나타냈습니다.
표현주의.x: Expressionist painters showed their inner feelings with strong colors.

분개하다.m: to be indignant, to resent, to be outraged
분개하다.x: Citizens were outraged by the government's decision.

경황없이.m: in a rush, frantically, with no time to think
경황없이.ex: 이사 준비로 한 주를 경황없이 보냈어요.
경황없이.x: I spent the week in a frantic rush getting ready to move.
경황없이.e: 경황 'leeway, presence of mind' + 없이: with no room to think.
경황없이.t: Common apology: 경황이 없어서 연락을 못 드렸어요 'I was so swamped I couldn't get in touch'.

편파보도.x: Viewers protested the broadcaster's biased reporting.

기술되다.m: to be described, to be written (in a text)
기술되다.ex: 그 사건은 교과서에 자세히 기술되어 있어요.
기술되다.x: That event is described in detail in the textbook.
기술되다.t: Homonym warning: 기술 (技術) means 'technology, skill.' Context tells them apart.

내재하다.m: to be inherent, to be intrinsic

일장춘몽.m: a fleeting dream, the vanity of life and glory
일장춘몽.ex: 그 화려했던 시절도 이제는 일장춘몽이 되었어요.
일장춘몽.x: Those glamorous days have now become nothing but a passing dream.
일장춘몽.e: Literally 'one spring night's dream' — pleasant but over quickly.
